metadata.description: Smart contract audit response toolkit — validate findings with PoC tests, resolve confirmed vulnerabilities using TDD, and aggregate multiple campaigns into a deduplicated coverage grid with competition-style scoring. Review, resolve and aggregate in one plugin.

plugins.name: web3-audit-response-toolkit
plugins.description: Three-skill toolkit for smart contract audit response: (1) reviewing-audit-reports validates findings with PoC tests and grades audit quality, (2) resolving-audit-findings converts confirmed PoCs into regression tests and implements fixes using TDD, (3) aggregating-audit-campaigns deduplicates findings across campaigns and scores auditors with competition-style formulas.
